{{Top|leg}}
In [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the '''sternum''' was a flat [[Bone/Legends|bone]] that ran down the center of the [[Breast/Legends|chest]], to which the [[Rib/Legends|ribs]] were attached. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was put in a [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|life-supporting armor]] following his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] replaced his sternum with a perforated metal plate that could accommodate the cables running to a chest computer.<ref name="VaderReconstruction">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref>

The [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaurs]] that lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] possessed sternums composed of rigid bone. The sternum of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] mythosaur was removed and carved to create the [[Mandalore's Mask|ceremonial mask]] of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]], after his [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] conquered slaughtered the mythosaurs.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
